scenarios.name: a read: the key as a Bearer token, the SDK's User-Agent, the data
a read is tried again after 503 (Retry-After 0)
a read is tried again after 429, waiting the Retry-After
an order is sent again after 500 with the same Idempotency-Key
a change without a key is never sent twice
a Retry-After over a minute is not slept: RateLimitError with it
a refusal: RuleRejectedError with its code and the kept order's id
409: ConflictError
401: AuthenticationError, not tried again
an HTML body still becomes an error: http_<status>
a bare { error: text } body becomes an error too
iterating a list follows the cursors over every page
maxItems stops the iteration
maxItems reached at a page's end asks no further page
an unknown enum value and an unknown field are kept, never fatal
a decimal goes out exactly as given
with no request left in the window, the next call waits for its reset
409 operation_in_progress (retryable) is asked again with the same Idempotency-Key
a 503 the API marks not retryable (sandbox_disabled) is not asked again
a 304 Not Modified is no error: the call answers nothing
a 2xx whose body is not JSON is an error: http_<status>
a 2xx with no body at all is an error too: http_<status>, never an empty answer
an error keeps retryable and doc_url
a page keeps the list's other fields (history_complete)
a baseUrl written as the REST address (ending in /v1) is its host
a fractional Retry-After is waited, not read as 0

local.name: a live key on a sandbox client fails before any request
the key never shows when the client is printed
a webhook signature checks with the secret, any of a rotation's two, and not after the tolerance
a client without a key is made, and sends no Authorization

extra.name: a forged signature with a non-ASCII character is bad_signature
the genuine signature after a forged non-ASCII one still checks
a timestamp beyond any clock is stale
a signed body that is no event is bad_body
webhook.ping: the WebhookPayload, test and environment kept

streams.name: account: after 1012 it resumes from the last event, and tells each event once
account: 4008 (too far behind) reconnects without resume
account: 4001 (the key ended) ends the stream with AuthenticationError, never reconnecting
market: every subscription is made again after a reconnect
account: an upgrade refused with 429 is tried again after its Retry-After, never thrown (no error listener)
account: an upgrade refused with 401 ends the stream with the API's error, never reconnecting
account: an error frame ends the stream with a ValidationError naming the account
account: a resume the server cannot cover is told as a gap
market: three heartbeats of silence reconnect and subscribe again
market: an unsubscribe with no options ends that market; the others are made again after a reconnect
market: a symbol the server refused is not asked again after a reconnect

vocabulary.scenarios: call { resource, method, path, body, query, iterate, max_items }; client { base_url_suffix } (the mock URL plus it as baseUrl); expect { ok, requests, result (null: the call answered nothing), error { code, status, retryable, doc_url }, items, cursors, first_body, min_elapsed_ms, checks [bearer, user_agent, same_idempotency_key], page_fields (the page keeps them, in the language's naming), paths (the request paths, in order) }
vocabulary.local: check: redaction | webhook_vectors | keyless (a client with api_key null is made; a public call sends no Authorization)
vocabulary.webhook_vectors: the base vector (signature, rotation, now_ms, want) and extra[]: { signature, body, timestamp, want | error } verified with secret and now_ms
vocabulary.rules_vectors: cases[]: { fn, args, mode?, want | error: true (a ValidationError of the SDK's own) }
vocabulary.streams: steps send | expect | reply | close | wait_ms | refuse { refuse, retry_after, body }; subscribe / unsubscribe (market: the calls the runner makes, in order); expect { events, connections, resume, first_message, error { code, account_id }, frames, resubscribe, unsubscribe_sent, limits (the stream's limits from the hello), gap (the event id the gap is told after) }
